statement: 5. Core Frontend Invariants: **Container Invariant**: `.container` owns `max-width`, `margin: 0 auto`, and horizontal padding only. Never combine `.container` on the same element with grid, flex, or component classes.

statement: 5. Core Frontend Invariants: **Zero Reduced-Motion**: Never add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion)` overrides (keep brand motion intact).
subject: 5. Core Frontend Invariants

statement: 5. Core Frontend Invariants: **Element Differentiation**: Always distinguish Image Slots `[🖼️]`, Colored Boxes `[🎨]`, Semantic Headings `[🏷️ H1-H6]`, and CTA Buttons `[🔘]`.
subject: 5. Core Frontend Invariants
